title: Completed pullback of a complete object equals normalized clopen restriction
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $S$, an open $U$ whose underlying subset is closed, and any normalized coefficient restriction datum $d$ [def-sf-clopen-restriction-data, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every quotient-derived-complete complex $K$ of completed coefficient modules on $S$ [def-weil-derived-complete, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], the specified completed derived pullback of $K$ to $U$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] is isomorphic to the exact derived ordinary restriction given by $d$. No affineness, weak contractibility, constructibility or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09C3, restriction to the disjoint affine opens; derived.tex Tag 08TC. Comparison step 3 of lem-sf-residue-lisse-clopen-bases.

proof.text: Lift the finite and completed ring comparisons of d through the fully faithful forgetful functor from commutative ring sheaves. Their normalization on constants and quotient projections yields an OpenCompletedRestriction.Coefficients datum. Uniqueness identifies it with the existing normalized datum; thus the ordinary module restrictions, and their exact derived functors, are isomorphic.

Apply clopenIntegralCompletionRestriction to express completed pullback as ordinary restriction of quotient completion. The canonical completion unit is invertible on K, so apply ordinary restriction to its inverse and compose with the preceding derived isomorphism.

theorem sf_clopen_complete_pullback_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsClosed (U : Set S))
    (d : SfClopenCoefficientRestriction.{u, u} l E S U)
    (K : IntegralOnSlice.D.{u, u} l E S none)
    (hK : IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S K) :
    Nonempty ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E U.ι).obj K ≅
      (sfClopenDerivedRestriction.{u, u} (l := l) (E := E) d).obj K)
